description: FP64 GEMM benchmark using cuBLAS (NVIDIA) or rocBLAS (AMD). Computes C = A * B where A is M×K, B is K×N, C is M×N (row-major, FP64). Uses row-major to col-major BLAS trick. Reports GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: matrix_dim
scaling_param.description: Square matrix dimension M=N=K; controls total FLOP count (2*M*N*K)
